# dav1d-sys (from CrabbyAvif)

CrabbyAvif's `sys/dav1d-sys` crate at commit `193e354e10f6a9f82217dfdbae836c4310ea3992` of
https://github.com/webmproject/CrabbyAvif (Apache-2.0, `LICENSE`), put in place of the original by the workspace's
`[patch."https://github.com/webmproject/CrabbyAvif"]`. `wrapper.h` is unchanged; the rest differs:

- `build.rs` is new. The original finds dav1d through a local meson build inside the crate or pkg-config and runs
  bindgen (which needs libclang). This one links the static `dav1d.lib` in `SNOWLARK_DAV1D_DIR` (made by
  `tools/dav1d/build.ps1` from the release `tools/dav1d/pin.txt` names).
- `src/bindings.rs` is bindgen's output for `wrapper.h` with the original build script's allowlist, generated by
  `tools/dav1d/build.ps1 -Bindings` (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) and checked in.
- `src/lib.rs` includes that file instead of `OUT_DIR`'s, and adds `LINKED` and the `missing` module: without the
  library, the functions CrabbyAvif calls are defined here and fail, so a build without dav1d still links.
